summary: Meta renamed its llama-recipes GitHub package to llama-cookbook and deprecated the old package name, alongside a large batch of community-contributed recipe fixes and additions.

practices.reason: Teams depending on the llama_recipes package name need to migrate to llama_cookbook before the old name is fully deprecated.
practices.quote: This release changes the package name from `llama_recipes` to `llama_cookbook` and deprecates the `llama_recipes` package name.
